sloka: अवश्यमेव दातव्या परस्मै सेति सन्ध्यया ।चिन्तयित्वा सुता दत्ता विद्युत्केशाय राघव ।। ७.४.२१ ॥
transliteration: avaśyameva dātavyā parasmai seti sandhyayā ।cintayitvā sutā dattā vidyutkeśāya rāghava ।। 7.4.21 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, Sandhya, having thought that her daughter must certainly be given to another, thus gave her daughter to Vidhyutkesha.
